sections: Our approach

Authors write pages in Word or Google Docs in your SharePoint or Google Drive, and Edge Delivery publishes them as pages. This applies only when you authors in documents; with Experience Workspace or AEM Sites, authoring stays in Adobe.
What we would do

We will plan the site and root folder with your IT, run Adobe's app registration and site grant with their Microsoft 365 admin (or share the Google Drive folder), set the site configuration, check preview and publish in Sidekick, and train the authors.

We will turn Brand Visibility findings and your search strategy into the site plan and information architecture; design and build the block library and page templates on Edge Delivery; set up authoring, the CDN route (Adobe's managed CDN or your own, confirmed in discovery) and the agreed integrations; build the agreed pages; and set up Brand Visibility's Optimize at Edge routing on that CDN.
We will train authors to edit pages and content in the Universal Editor and hand over authoring guides for the site's components and templates.

We will assess the current sites, vendors and content debt; rationalize duplicated components and templates; decide Edge Delivery versus traditional AEM for the agreed page set; and set the target architecture, integrations and governance model with your executives.

sections: Our approach

Google Ads, Pinterest, Snapchat and TikTok sources come with CJA (Adobe states no license line for Meta Ads, so confirm it). Experience Platform creates the paid media datasets itself, and ad spend joins web conversions through the campaign, ad group and ad IDs in landing page URLs, at the aggregate level.
What we would do

For the agreed ad accounts (Google Ads, Meta, Pinterest, Snapchat or TikTok): we will your ad admins approve access in each network; we authorizes the Experience Platform advertising sources, which create the paid media datasets, and adds them to the CJA connection and data view as summary data.

We will derived fields that read the network and campaign IDs from landing page URLs, summary data groups, and Workspace reports for web ROAS, cost per web order and the gap between what the networks report and what the site records.
We will plan the upgrade path, implement Web SDK alongside the Analytics source connector for history, port reporting API use and exports, and migrate projects and components.
After launch
Each month we will run flow, fallout and attribution analysis on priority journeys, report findings to stakeholders and recommend next actions.
